messages:
Maya: dropped a fresh iteration of the version history scrubber + compact timeline in Figma: https://figma.com/file/ijkl9012 (frames: 'History Scrub v1', 'Compact Timeline - keyboard')

Elliot: nice. UX concern: when you scrub to an old version the right panel opens with actions; we shouldn't surface 'Promote' for very old versions (confusing). suggest: show 'Compare' and 'Create rollback proposal' instead.

Rina: a11y notes: timeline scrub must be keyboard operable. propose left/right arrows to move between entries, Home/End to jump, and Enter to open details. add aria-describedby for the scrubber with total versions count. also for the mini-map we need aria-hidden on purely decorative SVGs.

Marco: microcopy: change 'Restore' to 'Create rollback proposal' and tooltips should include short context: 'Create a rollback proposal to route traffic back to this version'. keeps legal/pm folks happier.

Taylor: animation thoughts: when scrubbing, animate the preview diff but respect reduced-motion. also when a version is eligible for immediate promote show a small key shortcut hint: 'P' to promote (with confirmation). we should add a keyboard mnemonic doc in keyboard shortcuts modal.

Rina: screen reader detail: when focus lands on a timeline item, read out version id, timestamp, and status (e.g., 'v23, deployed 2 days ago, active 5%'). for reorders, use aria-live="polite" and avoid firing announcements for every health ping. debounce to 2s.

Elliot: sorting: default history is newest-first in timeline scrubber (makes comparing recent changes easier). we still surface active canaries above the scrubber. nothing else.

Maya: decisions: keep active canaries pinned above scrubber, allow scrubber newest-first, keyboard nav (arrow/Home/End/Enter), debounce live announcements 2s, change 'Restore' -> 'Create rollback proposal', add 'P' promote shortcut and list in shortcuts modal, mini-map decorative SVGs aria-hidden, reduced-motion respected for diffs. Rina/Elliot/Taylor — can you validate keyboard labels and shortcut hints in Figma?

Marco: one more microcopy: confirmation step for quick-promote should say 'Promote to production (this will route X% to vY)'. include commit id and a short 'why' line if the author supplied a changelog.

Maya: thanks — I'll update frames and include a small annotation about debounce/reorder behavior for engineers. tagging SRE for the 2s debounce. :white_check_mark:
